names.v0.12.0: Reports and units in your own language
names.v0.10.3: Standard and reduced VAT — selectable per item
names.v0.10.0: Logo in the report header + formulas in cells
names.v0.8.6: Markups corrected in the report summary
names.v0.8.4: Code picker + compact client budget estimate

v0.12.0: Printed and PDF reports appear in your own language, with a separate "Report language" setting (Preferences → General) that follows the interface language by default
Units are shown translated, for example "h" instead of "uur" — saved files stay unchanged
Import messages now appear on screen; those from FIEBDC-3 (.bc3) in your own language
English is the default language for new installations and the online demo, with an English sample estimate
Long button names in the ribbon now break at a syllable instead of mid-word
v0.11.0: The interface is now available in 39 languages — pick yours under Preferences → General, or let the app follow your system language
Right-to-left support for Arabic, Farsi, Hebrew and Urdu: the whole layout mirrors along
English used to stay half Dutch; the language setting was locked internally and over 500 texts were hard-coded — both fixed
FIEBDC-3 (.bc3) import and export: the Spanish standard for estimates and price databases (Presto, Arquímedes, Menfis, TCQ)
macOS: the "damaged" error resolved and the build itself repaired; "What's new" now appears in your own language
v0.10.3: New markup row "Reduced VAT" (9%) alongside "Standard VAT" — existing estimates get it automatically
Mark chapters, items or lines as reduced-rate via right-click; children inherit the rate and the grid shows a VAT label
Taxable base calculated pro rata from the marking (markups included) or entered manually in the markups panel
VAT split applied throughout all reports (IBIS shows the standard/reduced base separately) and the MCP server
Fixes: VAT counted twice in the Bouw 1 summary, and a VAT-inclusive amount shown under the label "Contract sum excl. VAT"
v0.10.0: Company logo top right in the report header (transparent, scales along); header height and line colour adjustable
Formulas in numeric cells (=12.2*2.22 or 12,2*2,2) — and the dropped-decimal bug is fixed
Markups: enter the final amount excl. VAT and the rounding becomes the difference automatically; VAT over the rounded amount
Main contract: sum lines with "+", an optional S column (adjustable inherited from the chapter) and subtotals-only views
Work faster: prices ±%, Ctrl+F find and replace, collapse by level, multi-step undo, text lines with word wrap
v0.9.0: BasCalc import: cost price and contract sum match Excel to the cent (flat markups + fixed rounding item)
Work description and main contract in specification layout: no cell borders, indented paragraphs, subtotal per paragraph
The + button beside the row adds a calculation line; quantities on/off directly in the report toolbar
Save as now defaults to .ifcCalc and protects the original source file
New green logo; navigation and dialog fixes (spreadsheet ↔ estimate)
v0.8.8: Excel/CSV import: amounts sometimes ended up as € 0 — fixed
Excel/CSV import now also via the MCP server (tool import_excel_csv)
v0.8.7: Excel/CSV import with column mapping — read free-form Excel/CSV layouts and map the columns yourself
New formats: STABU SUFX (XML specification) and legacy RAW (.rsu)
Price catalogue (BMEcat/DICO) → straight into the resource library
v0.8.6: The report summary shows the correct markup percentages and respects customised rates (previously "General overheads" could show 0%)
Markup model cleaned up internally; all reports now calculate from the same source
v0.8.5: Many more import formats: .cuf, .dnc, .xtb (with detail lines), .rsx, .s01 and .ifcx
White screen on Windows fixed (WebView falls back to software rendering)
Import engine rebuilt cleanly; totals match the source files exactly
v0.8.4: Code field: pick STABU/NL-SfB codes by double-clicking (and add your own)
Estimate import (.dnc): now opens straight away as a compact client budget report
Project, logos and variants moved to the ribbon; properties cleaned up
v0.8.3: Change tracking: choose whether the whole row or only the changed cell is highlighted
Changes also visible in the report PDF
Estimate import: client budget estimates (.dnc) imported directly and opened via File → Open
Client budget report option; per-line change history (who/when/what)
v0.8.2: Estimating assistant: chat history per estimate, several questions at once
OpenAEC features (sign-in, cloud storage) behind a setting
v0.8.1: Clear AI error messages; assistant text can be selected and copied
v0.8.0: The estimating assistant applies changes directly in the open document
Open .calc/.mdb files containing JSON as a native OCS project
v0.7.10: Hide/show columns by right-clicking the column header
Hours and Markups tabs combined; IBIS-style report (Bouw 2)
